items.title: ‘Like a drill going into my eye’: why the mystery over Havana syndrome refuses to die

sentences.en: ‘Like a drill going into my eye’: why the mystery over Havana syndrome refuses to die.
sentences.zh: “就像钻进我的眼睛” ：为什么关于哈瓦那综合症的谜团拒绝死亡。

sentences.en: Dozens of CIA officers have been afflicted by debilitating symptoms over the past decade.
sentences.zh: 在过去十年中，数十名中情局官员患有使人虚弱的症状。

sentences.en: Are they the result of ‘mass hysteria’?
sentences.zh: 它们是“大规模歇斯底里”的结果吗？

sentences.en: Or are they from attacks with an energy weapon and, if so, who is responsible?
sentences.zh: 或者他们是来自能量武器的攻击，如果是，谁应该对此负责？

sentences.en: And has there been a cover-up?
sentences.zh: 有没有掩盖？

sentences.en: Shortly after 1am one night in April 2019, a CIA officer on a work trip to London was jolted awake in his hotel room by the most intense head pain he had ever experienced.
sentences.zh: 2019年4月某天晚上凌晨1点后不久，一名前往伦敦出差的中情局官员在他的酒店房间里被他经历过的最强烈的头痛惊醒。

sentences.en: His body was soaked with sweat and he felt like his eyes were spinning in their sockets.
sentences.zh: 他满身是汗，眼睛好像在眼窝里旋转。

sentences.en: He manoeuvred his way out of bed, hoping to make it to the bathroom to vomit, but found his sense of balance had deserted him.
sentences.zh: 他从床上爬了起来，希望能到卫生间去呕吐，但发现他的平衡感已经抛弃了他。

sentences.en: Eventually, he fell back into a fitful, shallow sleep.
sentences.zh: 最终，他又回到了断断续续的浅度睡眠中。

sentences.en: The next day, arriving at the work meeting he had travelled for, the officer found he could not remember the names of colleagues in the room, people he knew well.
sentences.zh: 第二天，到达他出差的工作会议时，警官发现他不记得房间里同事的名字，他很熟悉的人。

sentences.en: As the meeting got under way, he could barely follow the discussion.
sentences.zh: 随着会议的进行，他几乎无法跟上讨论的步伐。

sentences.en: Initially, he chalked it up to a terrible – if rather odd – case of food poisoning.
sentences.zh: 最初，他将其归结为一个可怕的–如果相当奇怪的话–食物中毒病例。

sentences.en: The quake caused buildings and roads to collapse but the country appeared to escape widespread destruction or deaths A magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck southern Panama on Friday, damaging buildings and sending thousands into the streets, but the country appeared to escape widespread destruction or deaths.

items.title: Introducing Clef-omni with full multimodality, plus a faster Clef and a cheaper Clef-flash

sentences.en: Introducing Clef-omni with full multimodality, plus a faster Clef and a cheaper Clef-flash.
sentences.zh: 推出Clef-omni ，提供全面的多模态，以及更快的Clef和更便宜的Clef-flash。

sentences.en: Following last week’s release of Clef and Clef-flash , Cloudflare’s open-weight decision models, we decided to bring forth more gifts.
sentences.zh: 继上周发布Cloudflare的开放式决策模型Clef和Clef-flash之后，我们决定推出更多礼物。

sentences.en: Today, we’re releasing Clef-omni, which takes in audio and video input alongside text and image.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们发布了Clef-omni ，它可以接收音频和视频输入以及文本和图像。

sentences.en: We also cut the price of Clef-flash so it is now cheaper than Jev, and we made Clef faster.
sentences.zh: 我们还降低了Clef-flash的价格，因此它现在比Jev便宜，我们使Clef更快。

sentences.en: Although the model game is still early for Cloudflare, innovation and iteration is in our DNA, and we apply these principles to everything we do.
sentences.zh: 虽然Cloudflare的模型游戏还为时尚早，但创新和迭代是我们的DNA ，我们将这些原则应用于我们所做的一切。

sentences.en: In fact, the story of Clef came together over the course of less than a week.
sentences.zh: 事实上， Clef的故事在不到一周的时间里汇集在一起。

sentences.en: We decided we wanted to do something in the decision model space on a Friday evening, trained the model over the weekend, and launched it on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 我们决定在周五晚上在决策模型空间中做一些事情，在周末训练模型，并在周四推出。

sentences.en: Even with such a short timeline, we were able to ship performant, high-quality, open-weight models for the community — imagine what more we can do in the future.
sentences.zh: 即使在如此短的时间内，我们也能够为社区提供高性能、高质量、开放式的模型--想象一下我们未来还能做些什么。

sentences.en: For today, we’re excited to keep up the momentum with new additions and improvements to our Clef family of models.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们很高兴能够通过Clef系列车型的新增和改进来保持这一势头。

sentences.en: This is just the beginning, and we’ll continue to get better, faster, cheaper, and more innovative.
sentences.zh: 这只是一个开始，我们将继续变得更好、更快、更便宜、更具创新性。

sentences.en: Clef-omni takes audio, video, image, and text input Our new Clef-omni model is able to take audio, video, image, and text input.
sentences.zh: Clef-omni采集音频、视频、图像和文本输入我们的新型Clef-omni模型能够采集音频、视频、图像和文本输入。

sentences.en: This changes the paradigm for decision models, which have been largely text-only since the debut of Jev from TypeSafe.
sentences.zh: 这改变了决策模型的范式，自从TypeSafe的Jev首次亮相以来，决策模型基本上都是纯文本的。

sentences.en: Hack the World: Why hackathons are still the best place to learn to build.

sentences.en: Someone bursts through the door and announces, There s pizza!
sentences.zh: 有人冲进门，宣布： “披萨来了！”

sentences.en: Nearby, a team has duct tape and cardboard holding its prototype together.
sentences.zh: 附近有一个团队，有胶带和纸板将原型固定在一起。

sentences.en: Another is debugging a model that won t detect their movements.
sentences.zh: 另一个是调试无法检测其运动的模型。

sentences.en: This is a common scene during hackathons, and for a lot of people they re the place to learn to build.
sentences.zh: 这是黑客马拉松期间的常见场景，对于很多人来说，他们是学习构建的地方。

sentences.en: During several recent hackathons, we followed dozens of participants from the badge line to final demos and asked them what keeps them coming back.
sentences.zh: 在最近的几场黑客马拉松中，我们跟踪了数十名参与者，从徽章系列到最终演示，并询问他们是什么让他们回来。

sentences.en: Two days of intense focus Teams come up with ideas for robots, apps, websites, hardware, and more, then try to get prototypes working before time runs out.
sentences.zh: 为期两天的专注团队提出了机器人、应用程序、网站、硬件等的想法，然后尝试在时间用完之前让原型工作。

sentences.en: These aren t small things, these are big endeavors, and they re going to try to do it in basically two days.
sentences.zh: 这些都不是小事，这些都是很大的努力，他们基本上会在两天内尝试完成。

sentences.en: Kyle, hackathon participant Yana describes it as two days of intense focus on one small experimental project that moves the needle forward.
sentences.zh: Kyle ，黑客马拉松参与者Yana将其描述为对一个推动针向前移动的小型实验项目的两天强烈关注。

sentences.en: For Nithya, it s a rare chance to work as hard as you can on something you re proud of.
sentences.zh: 对于Nithya来说，这是一个难得的机会，可以尽你所能地努力做一些你引以为豪的事情。

sentences.en: It is basically an invention marathon.
sentences.zh: 这基本上是一场发明马拉松。

sentences.en: Mike, hackathon participant You don t need a computer science degree For most of computing history, building software required years of specialized training.
sentences.zh: Mike ，黑客马拉松参与者您不需要计算机科学学位对于大多数计算历史，构建软件需要多年的专业培训。
